name: Dify
summary: Open-source platform to build LLM apps with visual workflows, RAG pipelines and agents.
description: Self-host with Docker Compose or use Dify Cloud to build LLM apps on a visual workflow canvas: hundreds of models, a prompt IDE, a RAG pipeline with PDF and PPT ingestion, sandboxed agents that use tools and MCP servers, and LLMOps observability (Opik, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix). Cloud, community and enterprise editions ship with APIs for backing your own product.
contains: visual workflow canvas and prompt IDE
RAG pipeline with PDF and PPT ingestion
hundreds of LLMs from dozens of inference providers and self-hosted solutions
agents with sandbox, MCP servers and tools from the Dify Marketplace
observability integrations: Opik, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix
self-host with Docker Compose (2+ cores, 4 GiB RAM) or use Dify Cloud
license: modified Apache 2.0 with multi-tenant and logo conditions
